scenes.line1: How do you test old code
scenes.say: How do you test legacy code without breaking anything important?

scenes.label: Capture
scenes.sub: Write characterization tests first—record what the code does now.
scenes.say: First, write characterization tests. These capture exactly how the legacy code behaves today.
Here's my process: write tests to document outputs, run them to confirm, then refactor safely.

scenes.question: How do you improve legacy test coverage?
scenes.wrong: Just add new tests after refactoring.
scenes.right: Write characterization tests first, then refactor.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Don't just add tests after you refactor. Always write characterization tests first, so you know you're not breaking anything.
